purpose: Peer-court comparison set (n=90 across 3 courts × 30 case-type slots). Tests whether the v0.2 rubric translates beyond the DIFC/ADGM/SICC family to other commercial courts of comparable stature, including a civil-law foil (ICCP-CA Paris). The falsifiable prediction is that all three peer courts score near-ceiling on per-ruling primitives — confirming the rubric measures procedural form rather than DIFC/ADGM/SICC-specific idiom. The civil-law foil specifically tests PR3.
scoring_provenance: Each entry is a class-default slot keyed by (court, claim type). Slots are NOT bound to named cases; binding + hand-validation happens via scripts/fetch_peer_courts.py (TODO) and an IRR exercise. Coder tag 'MaximLabs (provisional-class-default)' marks this provenance. These provisional scores function as the falsifiable prediction; deviations on hand-validation are themselves the empirical contribution.
